==Patch Information==
* Group Stage 1 Week 1-3 are synchronised to [https://main.aov.garena.co.id/post/patch-notes14feb26-en February {{Ordinal|14|sup=yes}} patch]. Hero {{heroIcon|dyadia|24x24px}} [[Dyadia]] is not allowed to use.
* Group Stage 1 Week 4-6 are synchronised to [https://main.aov.garena.co.id/post/patch-notes11mar26-en March {{Ordinal|11|sup=yes}} patch].
** Hero {{heroIcon|dyadia|24x24px}} [[Dyadia]] is enabled from Group Stage 1 Week 4.
* Group Stage 2, Playoffs 1, 2 and 3 are synchronised to [https://lienquan.garena.vn/chi-tiet-ban-cap-nhat-le-hoi-5v5-08-04-2026/ April {{Ordinal|8|sup=yes}} patch].
** Hero [[File:Flowborn Marksman AoV hero icon.jpg|24x24px|link=Flowborn/Marksman]] [[Flowborn/Marksman|Flowborn (Marksman)]] is enabled from Group Stage 2.
* Grand Final is synchronised to [https://main.aov.garena.co.id/post/patch-notes23apr26-en April {{Ordinal|23|sup=yes}} patch].
